methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: A statistical model which provides a functional relationship between the level of energy use and the level and type of various production activities, material inputs quality, and external factors

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper presents an approach to statistically measure plant specific energy efficiency when there are multiple outputs

level_3b.evidence_quote: Wet corn milling (SIC 2046 or NAICS 311221), which is also referred to as corn refining

stage1.notes: Own empirical case = corn refining / wet corn milling (SIC 2046, NAICS 311221), a food-manufacturing sector, fitted by stochastic frontier to 37 plant-years (the paper's own case, not an illustrative example). Plants operate continuously ~365 d/yr so A9 type_of_organisation=continuous process (broad 24/7 def); but corn refining is NOT on the closed Level-3B sector list, so level_3b=false per the v2.3 unlisted-but-continuous-flow rule. Flag for human 3B decision.

sector_of_activity.evidence_quote: using stochastic frontier analysis on plant level data for corn refining
